errors.text_span: Es gibt zwei Balkengruppen für jedes Land
errors.evidence: The chart displays one group of bars for each of the three countries. Each group consists of two bars. The description incorrectly states that there are two groups of bars for each country.
The mauve bar for 'Deutschland' representing the 25- to 34-year-old age group is at approximately 13%, not 16%.
In the sentence 'Die Niederlande zeigen Balken mit Werten von 24 % und 23 %,' the value for the second bar (25- to 34-year-olds) is incorrect. The chart shows this value to be 15%, not 23%.
In the sentence 'Die USA zeigen Balken von 18 % bzw. 15 %,' the value for the first bar (18- to 24-year-olds) is incorrect. The chart shows this value to be approximately 24%, not 18%.
The blue bar for 'Deutschland' is closer to 11% than 12%.
In the sentence 'Die Niederlande zeigen Balken mit Werten von 24 % und 23 %,' the value for the first bar is approximately 23%, not 24%.
In the sentence 'Die USA zeigen Balken von 18 % bzw. 15 %,' the value for the second bar (25- to 34-year-olds) is incorrect. The chart shows this value to be approximately 17.5%, not 15%.
The description omits a small blue dot located above the 'Deutschland' bars, at a y-axis value of approximately 23%.

errors.text_span: beide in verschiedenen Blautönen und Lavendeltönen dargestellt
errors.evidence: This phrasing is ambiguous. It could imply that both bars contain both colors. A clearer description would be that one bar is blue and the other is lavender, corresponding to the legend.

errors.text_span: Die Balken für die Altersgruppe 18- bis 24-Jährige sind in einem helleren Blauton dargestellt, während die Balken für die Altersgruppe 25- bis 34-Jährige in einem helleren Lavendelton dargestellt sind.
errors.evidence: This sentence repeats the color mapping information that should have been integrated with the description of the legend or the first mention of the bar groups, making the description unnecessarily repetitive.
